19: As he is engaged in the commandment: As it is written (Exodus 12:17), "You must guard the matzot" - as [the wheat] requires guarding for the sake of the matzah from the time of the grinding and the sifting.
Who was with them: He attached himself to them on the journey.
That is what one does: By way of a question.
To those who accompany as part of the group. We leave them and go?
